title: 3D Print Electronics with AI
content: Printing techniques have been instrumental in developing flexible and stretchable electronics including organic light-emitting diode displays, organic thin film transistor arrays,  electronic skins, organic electrochemical transistors for biosensors and neuromorphic computing, as well as flexible solar cells with low-cost processes such as inkjet printing, ultrasonic nozzle, roll-to-roll coating. The rise of additive manufacturing provides even more opportunities to print electronics in automated and customizable ways. In this work, we will review the current technologies of printing electronics (including printed batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells, sensors), especially with 3D printing. In this age of ongoing AI revolution, the application of AI algorithms is discussed, in terms of combining them with 3D printing and printing electronics for a smart and efficient future.
